title: Aether post-confirmation replay audit of the 57 remaining units (directive s1, D1)
objective: Independent native re-execution of every confirmatory unit not yet fully replayed; per-unit match/mismatch of CUT_B / CUT_N arrays; classes recomputed separately; C-018's verdict and rule untouched.
problem: POST-CONFIRMATION AUDIT, separate from C-018 (do not modify rso/aether/runs/, RESULT.md, FROZEN.json, any pinned file, or the decision rule; do not replace the result). Pin: rso/aether/FROZEN.json blob 9fe0fcb4 at commit 1f2d2444f (RELEASE.json) and the Aether source pin it names; record both in the audit. Already fully replayed (read their records): the six preregistered sample units RX 8192, 8204, 8216, 8228 and V1 8192, 8200 (rso/aether/runs/meta/analyse_full.out, full_replay_verified) and the integrator's RX 8201 (ops/campaigns/C-018/tasks/C-018-T050/TASK.json history: arrays_sha256 567d483e...). Re-execute the remaining 57 units (64 - 7) with their exact recorded inputs (law, seed, n, warm, H from each unit's committed meta JSON) through the pinned native path (rso.aether.adapter.native_unit, which calls Aether's own law_step / run_unit; the same call `confirm analyse` uses for its sample). For each unit compare the regenerated arrays (arrays_sha256 AND each of CUT_B / CUT_N first-divergence arrays) and the meta fields tree / B / N / origin / warm_digest against the committed evidence; record MATCH or MISMATCH with both digests. Then recompute every unit's class from the REPLAYED arrays with the frozen evaluator (rso.aether.evaluate, imported read-only) and tabulate it beside the committed class; recompute the RX/V1 dispositions from replayed evidence as a SEPARATE table labelled post-confirmation. Outcomes (directive s1): all MATCH -> 'the committed clamp evidence is reproducible under the pinned native execution implementation'; this closes the R1c missing-replay exposure within that trust boundary and does NOT prove the native transition physics correct. Any MISMATCH -> preserve the C-018 verdict, issue a QUALIFICATION WARNING, and state whether the mismatch changes any CONFIRMED / NOT_INTERVENTIONAL class or the RX disposition. Never repair evidence. Execution: ~65 s/unit, about 1 core-hour; NO new native seeds; harry1 CPU, at most two DETACHED OS processes (PowerShell Start-Process, logs redirected, PID recorded) writing one JSON per unit under rso/aether/audit/replay/ so a restart resumes; poll with short foreground checks. Commit the script, per-unit records, AUDIT.md (pins, method, table, outcome sentence, CPU used) and the command lines.
